verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents its own distributed mode, in which GPU worker nodes self-register with a frontend coordinator and scale horizontally. That plausibly spreads inference load across multiple GPUs, roughly data-parallel style. The evidence never mentions tensor or pipeline parallelism, splitting a single model across GPUs, or multi-GPU configuration within one node. missing for 10: tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, explicit data-parallel/replica semantics, multi-GPU-per-node configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can distribute inference across multiple GPUs using tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism

citations.quote: Distributed nodes: Add GPU worker nodes that self-register with a frontend coordinator
